<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def orng(fr):
    px=[(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if fr.ascii.split('\n')[i][j]=='O']
    rs=[p[0] for p in px]; cs=[p[1] for p in px]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
prev=orng(current_frame)
for k in range(10):
    action(['LEFT'])
    p=orng(current_frame)
    print('L',k,p)
    if p==prev: break
    prev=p
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
